chapters.title: Joy in trials
chapters.summary: Count it all joy when you face trials, for they produce patience. Ask God for wisdom. Be quick to listen, slow to speak, and be doers of the word, not hearers only.

chapters.title: Faith and works
chapters.summary: Do not show favoritism to the rich. Faith without works is dead: Abraham and Rahab showed their faith by what they did.

chapters.title: Taming the tongue
chapters.summary: The tongue is small but powerful, like a ship's rudder or a spark that sets a forest ablaze. Wisdom from above is pure, peaceable and gentle.

chapters.title: Draw near to God
chapters.summary: Fights come from selfish desires. God resists the proud but gives grace to the humble. Draw near to God and He will draw near to you. Life is a vapor.

chapters.title: The prayer of faith
chapters.summary: James warns rich oppressors and urges patience like a farmer waiting for rain. Pray for the sick and confess to one another; the prayer of a righteous person is powerful.
